mapper.select: SELECT * FROM av_script_version WHERE script_id = #{scriptId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_type = 'personal' AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND manual_idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS version_id, CAST(parent_version_id AS CHAR) AS parent_version_id, version_no, source_type, effective_character_count, estimated_duration_seconds, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(script_text) > 120 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(script_text, 120), '…') ELSE script_text END AS preview, created_at FROM av_script_version WHERE script_id = #{scriptId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_type = 'personal' AND owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY version_no DESC, id DESC
